title: Render a 3D model as game sprites
description: Blender renders a GLB with a fixed orthographic camera: directions facings (1, 4, 8 or 16; the first is south, the model facing the viewer) at pitch degrees above the ground (30 for 2:1 isometric, 35.264 true isometric, 50-60 top-down, 0 side view), frames per animation (animations=all, none, or names). Every frame shares one scale, and the facings turn about the model's origin when the model stands on it (pivot=auto; bounds turns about its middle). Writes the frames, one sheet (a row per animation and facing) and a JSON with each frame's rectangle and the anchor (the ground point under the model). engine=workbench is shaded and fast, flat shows the base colour with no shading, eevee is lit with materials and emission. A still model's facings share one row. antialias=false gives hard pixel edges. Convert other formats with mesh-convert first.
